# Runtime dependencies, derived from the imports the code actually makes.
#
# NOT generated by `pip freeze` against system Python. That produced 63 lines
# including RPM-installed OS packages such as aws-cfn-bootstrap==2.0, which does
# not exist on PyPI at that version and aborts the whole install on the first
# error -- leaving a venv with a working interpreter and no packages, which is
# more dangerous than no venv at all.
#
# Deliberately unpinned. This is the "what does it need" list; run
#     venv/bin/pip freeze > requirements.lock.txt
# after a successful install to capture the "what did it get" list, and use the
# lock file when you need to reproduce an environment exactly.

# Broker API.
smartapi-python

# smartapi-python imports logzero at module scope but does not declare it in
# its install_requires. Without this line the venv installs "successfully" and
# then dies on `import SmartApi` -- a failure that only shows up when the bot
# starts, which on this deployment means 09:00 on a trading morning.
logzero

# Also imported by SmartApi's transport layer without being declared.
six

# TOTP for the login flow
pyotp

# .env loading
python-dotenv

# SmartWebSocketV2 transport
websocket-client

# Scrip master download, option-chain fetches
requests

# Indicators, backtest maths
numpy
pandas

# Console tables in the reporting scripts
tabulate

# NOTE: boto3 is imported by deploy/lambda_ec2_scheduler.py, which runs in AWS
# Lambda where boto3 is part of the runtime. It is deliberately not listed here
# -- the trading instance does not need it.
